license.notes: Authored 2026-09-16 for Zoo 0.95.0 from the walker's own photographs of 1990s and modern trading-card shops, written up in docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md. Construction knowledge only: no brand, no trade dress and no mark from any of them reaches the tools -- every name the species paints comes from core/card_brands.py, which is invented, and a denylist test holds every painted string against the real card games, publishers, graders, leagues, teams and players a writer would reach for.

notes: The play area's black folding chair: a moulded seat pan on four splayed legs with a raked back on two posts under a cap rail. Reference: docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md, 'The walker's trading card shop references (2026-09-15)'. A VARIANT is the back -- one panel or two slats. RANGES: width 0.40 to 0.50, depth 0.44 to 0.56, height 0.78 to 0.92, which is the range a real folding chair covers; the seat is `folding_forms.SEAT_H` (0.455) or 55 % of the slot height, whichever is less. BUDGET: 500; measured worst 192 (the slatted back). BOXES AND NOT TUBES: a `prims.rod` leg at eight segments is 48 triangles against a box's 12, and a play area carries eight of these.
